traceMetadata.stage: Stage 23: Resilient Autonomous Operations & Recovery Control
traceMetadata.phase: Phase 9: Durable Recovery Control & Stage 09 Integration

scenarios.name: normal persisted decision
scenarios.description: Evaluates a valid recovery request and confirms atomic persistence into Stage 09 execution envelope and journal.

scenarios.name: restart
scenarios.description: Simulates browser/process restart by clearing in-memory cache and re-loading persisted decision from Stage 09 envelope.

scenarios.name: stale decision
scenarios.description: Decision TTL expired during application downtime; revalidation marks decision EXPIRED and emits journal event.

revalidationResult.reason: Recovery control decision expired during downtime

scenarios.name: stale approval
scenarios.description: High-risk operation whose operator approval expired while offline fails closed to REQUIRE_APPROVAL upon restart.

revalidationResult.reason: Governance authority has become stale; consequential action requires Stage 21 revalidation

scenarios.name: completed operation
scenarios.description: External call completed successfully while AryaOS was offline; Stage 22 empirical truth prevents duplicate execution.

revalidationResult.reason: Operation already completed successfully while offline (Stage 22 empirical truth)

scenarios.name: unknown operation
scenarios.description: Dispatched action with absent external verification preserves UNKNOWN epistemic state after restart without guessing.

scenarios.name: interrupted reconciliation
scenarios.description: Reconciliation probe interrupted across restart; respects MAX_RECONCILIATION_ATTEMPTS=3 bound and escalates instead of looping.

revalidationResult.reason: Maximum reconciliation attempts (3) reached across restart; escalating to operator

scenarios.name: interrupted compensation
scenarios.description: Interrupted compensating reverse action must be verified against Stage 22 empirical state before any replay attempt.

revalidationResult.reason: Compensation already executed successfully; no repeat compensation required

scenarios.name: active cascade
scenarios.description: Active cascade containment decision (PAUSE) survives restart and cannot be downgraded to RETRY or RESUME.

revalidationResult.reason: Active cascade containment (PAUSE) survives restart and cannot be downgraded

scenarios.name: duplicate request
scenarios.description: Repeated recovery request for already evaluated requestId returns cached persisted decision idempotently.

scenarios.name: lease protection
scenarios.description: Worker Alpha acquires single-runtime recovery lease; Worker Beta is blocked from concurrent execution until release.

workerBetaAcquisition.failureReason: Recovery decision is currently leased by worker 'worker-alpha'

scenarios.name: governance revalidation
scenarios.description: Privileged connector operation re-evaluates Stage 21 authority upon cold start and blocks unapproved execution.

revalidationResult.reason: Governance authority has become stale; consequential action requires Stage 21 revalidation

scenarios.name: safe escalation
scenarios.description: Supersedes expired or invalid recovery decision with an immutable governed escalation record.
